item.text: The playground is built, including a preview of each comet’s path before you release it. I’m checking the orbital motion and controls; it also starts paused when your system requests reduced motion.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
html = Path('/workspace/index.html').read_text()
script = html.split('<script>', 1)[1].split('</script>', 1)[0]
Path('/tmp/small-universe-check.js').write_text(script)
print('Extracted JavaScript for validation; HTML is %s bytes.' % len(html.encode()))
PY
node --check /tmp/small-universe-check.js"
